_doc: How the nearby= list treats each entity kind. Mirrors vanilla despawn rules: anything not listed here is tracked individually (tag + coords), which is the safe default for new or unknown mobs. Read via perception/entityClass.js.

_fields.background: Despawning ambient/water mobs that never matter individually. Summarized per type (cod×12(41m+)), no tags, and not reported as they drift in and out of sight.
_fields.threats: Hostile mobs minecraft-data does not type as 'hostile'. Every 'hostile'-typed entity is a threat automatically. Threats are always listed individually and never capped.
